# Run A: `112 101` (set of two PRs)

**1. Set routing.** Two PR tokens route the run through `reference/batch.md` before steps 1-7.

**2. Admission, before any side effects.** Each check runs locally, with no commands:
- There is no positional issue reference.
- The tokens 112 and 101 are distinct, so there are no duplicates.
- Both tokens are bare numbers, so they cannot name a different repository.
- The set has 2 PRs, within `parallel.maxTasks` 4.
- The harness is pi.

Admission passes. This is a typed set, so no `discovered, smallest first:` line is printed.

**3. Parent run folder.** I mint one parent `RUN_DIR` from the session checkout, following `post-selection-loop.md` `### Continuation record`. Creation succeeds. No roster or records exist yet.

**4. Gather, in argument order.** Each token is passed unchanged as `pr_token`:
- `gh pr view "112" --json number,author,headRefOid,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,headRepository,state,files,url,title,body,additions,deletions,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests --jq '<linearRefs projection, body cut to 300>'` returns the #112 row.
- `gh pr view "101" --json …same fields… --jq '…same projection…'` returns the #101 row.

**5. Viewer reads, once each for the typed set.**
- `gh api user --jq .login` returns `alex`.
- `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'` returns `acme/reviewers`.

**6. Ticket display reads.**
- `git remote get-url origin` returns `git@github.com:acme/widgets.git`, which resolves to `acme/widgets`.
- `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` resolves the default branch.
- `git show <ref>:<path>` runs over the overrides search order. It finds no tracker override, so Linear IDs and one lookup are allowed.
- No Linear ID ends up needed, so no `linearis` lookup runs.

**7. Ticket and reviewer resolution for each PR.**
- **#112:** The author is `pat`, with no pending requests, so it shows as `by pat`. Its first closing reference is #22 in `acme/widgets`, which is origin, so it links to that issue's own URL.
- **#101:** The author matches `alex`, so it shows as `yours`. It has no closing reference. The branch `gh-45-retry` starts with `gh-45`, so it links to origin's issue 45.

**8. Message the human sees before provisioning.** This is plain text with no marker and no wait. It goes in the reply that carries the next tool call:

**PRs to gate:**
- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +300 -80, by pat, [#22](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/22) - use one resolver for all settings reads
- [#101](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101) +3 -1, yours, [#45](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/45) - raise the default retry timeout for slow requests

**Next step: serial provisioning (batch.md `## Provision serially`).** It starts with one `git fetch origin`. Worktrees are then provisioned one at a time in roster order, #112 then #101, using trusted configuration resolved from the base merge-base.
- Neither PR is from a fork.
- No `--rebase` was passed, so no set-wide confirmation is asked.
- No parent tracker tasks or per-PR records exist yet.

Stopping here.

# Run B: `97` (single PR, independent)

**1. Routing.** One PR token stays on the single-PR path.

**2. Run folder and tracker.**
- I mint the run folder and initialize its continuation record (`post-selection-loop.md` `### Continuation record`).
- `plan_tracker` `init` creates three stages: `gather`, `provision`, `verify`. There is no `sync` stage because `--rebase` was not passed.
- `gather` starts.

**3. Step 1 Gather (verification-brief.md Section A), first fixed reads.**
- `gh pr view "97" --json number,title,body,author,state,isDraft,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,mergeable,headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,files,additions,deletions,commits,reviews,closingIssuesReferences,reviewDecision,headRepository,maintainerCanModify,mergeStateStatus,url,mergeCommit,reviewRequests` returns open #97 by `robin`, with a pending request for User `alex`.
- `gh api user --jq .login` returns `alex`.
- `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq …` returns `acme/reviewers`.

**4. Ticket display reads.**
- `git remote get-url origin` returns `acme/widgets`.
- `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` and then `git show <ref>:<path>` over the overrides paths find no tracker override.

**5. Ticket and reviewer resolution.**
- **Ticket:** none found.
  - There are no closing references.
  - The branch `csv-export` has no `gh-<N>` and no Linear-shaped ID.
  - The title and description have no references.
  - So it shows as `no ticket`, and no lookup runs.
- **Reviewer:** the pending User request matches `alex`, so it shows as `by robin, requested from you`.

**6. Message the human sees before provisioning.** This is plain text with no marker and no wait. It goes in the reply that carries the next tool call, `gh run list`:

**PR to gate:**
- [#97](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/97) +40 -12, by robin, requested from you, no ticket - add a CSV export button to the widget list

**7. Rest of the gather.** Every number-only call uses `-R acme/widgets`.
- `gh run list -R acme/widgets -c <headRefOid> --json databaseId,status,conclusion,workflowName,url`
- `gh api graphql …viewerPermission, viewerCanUpdateBranch, viewerCanMergeAsAdmin, viewerCanClose… -f o=acme -f r=widgets -F n=97`
- `gh repo view acme/widgets --json nameWithOwner`
- `gh pr diff "97"`
- `gh api repos/acme/widgets/pulls/97/reviews --paginate`, which also gives the prior-review selection for `alex`.
- `gh api repos/acme/widgets/pulls/97/comments --paginate`
- `gh api repos/acme/widgets/issues/97/comments --paginate`
- `git worktree list --porcelain` shows no worktree for #97. This is discovery only.

**8. Gather result.**
- `issue_ref` is `null`.
- `viewer.role` is `requested reviewer`, and `is_author` is false.
- `gather` is marked complete.

**Next step: step 2 Provision + configure (`reference/assessment.md`).** It provisions the #97 worktree, resolves configuration from the merge-base, and selects the scope. With no ticket, scope comes from a spec at the head, or else the PR's stated intent. Verification and review will assess #97's gathered `headRefOid`.

Stopping here.
